answer: Sybil resistance needs a join cost scaling superlinearly with cluster size: each fresh identity inherits a provenance signal (device attestation, funding source, key adjacency), and required stake doubles per sibling sharing that signal. One honest agent pays the base rate once; an attacker minting a nebula of throwaway identities burns exponentially more locked collateral per head, while a beacon of provable history disambiguates the shared-provenance graph cheaply. That asymmetry is the saffron line between an economy and an impersonation farm.
